1.consolidated_definition: Que ocurre de forma fortuita, inesperada o inusual. Todo esto fue algo bien ‘random’ (al azar). (La coordinadora de mercadeo) me contactó por Instagram. Al principio yo pensé que no iba a pasar nada y no me ilusioné. Pero después se abrió la puerta y voy a demostrarles que no perdieron su tiempo conmigo.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Something that occurs by chance, unexpectedly or unusually.

This was all quite 'random'. (The marketing coordinator) contacted me through Instagram. At first, I thought nothing would come of it and didn't get my hopes up. But then the door opened and I'm going to show them they didn't waste their time with me.
